text:
maya: heads up — planning a progressive region rollout tomorrow 02:00 UTC (US -> EU -> APAC). Need capacity confirms, pinned-version check, and clear rollback triggers. who can validate warm pools and pre-warm queues?

jordan: I can run warm pool smoke in US and EU tonight. APAC warmups need help from on-call. ETA 2h.

leo: I'll validate the quota slices and open a tiny canary in US first. suggest canary=3% for 15m then 25% for 30m if healthy.

emily: release notes posted: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-22 — changed routing policy and a minor tokenizer fix. Pinning to v2026-03-22-rc1 for the rollout.

ops_sre: capacity check for US: nodes available 48/50 (warm=40). EU: nodes 30/32 (warm=25). APAC: nodes 12/20 (warm=8) — APAC is low, recommend conservative ramp and keep fallback to smaller quantized model.

maya: thanks — sounds like APAC needs a reduced traffic slice and a strict rollback gate. define rollback signals please (latency, error-rate, token-per-second).

leo: rollback triggers proposal: 1) p50 latency > 450ms for 5m AND p95 > 1.5s; 2) 5xx rate > 0.8% for 5m; 3) error budget burn > 30% in a 10m window. any objections?

jordan: agree. add model-quality regression alert: BLEU-like prompt set score drop > 3% for core prompts. We have automated evals hooked to canary.

deploy-bot: deploy queued — image: release-2026-03-22-rc1, plan: us(canary=3%/15m -> ramp25%), eu(staged after us), apac(staged last, cap=10% initial). Canaries: health probes enabled, rollback hooks configured.

ops_sre: action items: 1) jordan run warm-pool smoke by 2300 UTC; 2) leo configure canary gates (thresholds as above); 3) emily confirm release-notes link and support rotation; 4) maya coordinate on-call handoff at T-30m.

emily: confirmed release notes and support rotation. I'll post a short blurb in #general when US canary passes.

jordan: warm-pool smoke done for US/EU. logs: `us-warm: ok`, `eu-warm: ok`. APAC warm still low — created a short-lived extra-warm request (+4 nodes) pending approvals.

ops_sre: approved extra-warm for APAC for rollout window. APAC effective warm becomes 12. still lower headroom; keep cap and slower ramp.

leo: canary config pasted for visibility:
```
canary: {
  region: us,
  percent: 3,
  duration: 15m,
  gates: ["latency", "5xx_rate", "eval_regression"]
}
```

maya: perfect. final check: pin fallback to smaller-quant model in APAC if node pressure > 85% or latency trigger fires. can we automate fallback?

ops_sre: yes — we have a routing policy to redirect 20% -> quant-v2 when pressure=high; fallback automated via traffic-router with a 2m cool-off.

deploy-bot: canary starting in 5m for region=us. notify @on-call when canary reaches 10% ramp.

emily: posting release blurb in 10m after canary is green.

jordan: US canary smoke: p50=160ms, p95=420ms, 5xx=0.02% — green so far (10m).

leo: moving to 25% ramp in US. monitoring dashboards linked: https://console.redwood/rollouts/1778881234

ops_sre: US ramp stable at 25% for 20m. metrics good. proceeding to EU canary at 3%.

deploy-bot: eu canary started. apac remains on hold until eu green.

jordan: EU: p50=220ms, p95=520ms, 5xx=0.1% — within gates.

ops_sre: EU ramp to 30% after 15m of stability. APAC to start at 5% with fallback rules.

maya: launching APAC at 5% now. ops please watch thermal and queue depth closely.

ops_sre: APAC at 5% — cpu pressure ticked up but below 70%. watch for KV cache misses spiking.

leo: small regression detected on one eval prompt (score drop 3.8%) — tied to a rare tokenization case. it's affecting 0.02% of traffic. recommend rollback of APAC slice to previous model until hotfix deploy.

maya: rollback APAC slice now. deploy-bot, execute rollback to pinned v2026-03-21-stable for APAC slice.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for region=apac -> image: v2026-03-21-stable. traffic shifted in 1m.

emily: posting rollback note in release thread and pinging impacted partner teams.

jordan: monitoring APAC after rollback — metrics returning to baseline. planning a hotfix branch with tokenizer patch; will target next maintenance window.

maya: thanks team — summary: US/EU rolled, APAC rolled back due to eval regression. actions: jordan hotfix, leo update canary eval set to catch variant, ops_sre keep APAC warm and ready. closing thread and will file formal postmortem if regression persists. :thumbsup:
